label: <DEL> step of sequences starting with w (very sparse subset)
explanation: Fires almost only at the delimiter step (99% of mass), when the model is about to output original token 0, and almost always when that first token is w (about 90% of mass; the few others are l/s/x). It is extremely sparse: it fires on only about 0.6% of w-initial <DEL> steps, so precision is very low. Activations are more likely and larger when L is 6-7, when the token just before <DEL> is j (also u/e/g), and when the second token is w or x. Adding these conditions raises precision only to about 3% and costs a lot of recall, so the exact trigger is still a sparse conjunction that has not been found. Never fires during the copy phase and essentially never on original-phase tokens.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: prev_tok=j (+2.56), orig0=w (+2.44), phase=1 & out_tok=w (+2.38), orig1=w (+2.16), orig3=u (+1.66), orig2=u (+1.58). Lower it: in_first=0 (-2.33), prev_tok=v (-1.41), in_count=1 (-1.30), L=9 (-1.25).
